description: Raise a purchase order to a supplier from items and return its PO number and totals. unit_price is in MAJOR units; currency, VAT and the buyer block come from the shared profile. Free: 5 documents a calendar month.

currency.description: Defaults to your business default currency

discount_percent.description: Discount applied to every line, in percent

expected_delivery_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, when the goods or work are due

issue_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today in your business profile's timezone

currency.description: Only to state the line's currency; every line on one document must agree

description.description: every line needs a description, 500 characters or fewer

quantity.description: Units ordered, must be greater than zero

tax_rate.description: VAT percent for this line, overrides the business default

unit_price_minor.description: Price per unit in MINOR units: 9000 = 90.00 EUR, 90 = JPY 90. Never a decimal

notes.description: Free text printed under the totals, e.g. delivery address or terms

supplier.description: Supplier name or client id. A name the invoice server already knows brings its address, email and VAT id onto the order

supplier_address.description: Postal address for the SUPPLIER block, newlines allowed

supplier_email.description: Only if the user gave it; otherwise the stored client's email is used

tax_rate.description: VAT percent for lines with no rate of their own. Defaults to the business default

name: purchase_order_create
title: Raise a purchase order
